A subagent independently reviewed the complete cleanup delta and found no remaining issue. Early generation caught and resolved nontext transform interception. Native startup caught and resolved executable-relative payload loading. Every report is fresh and matches its generated stamp. Neutrality: 261 bit-identical scenes and 13 with previously measured backend variation, zero unexplained changes across the 274-scene baseline. Exact scene275 full/foreground MAD 0 on both PALs. All 24 final exact/shared-data/ordinary-blend controls use current generated stamps, remain strictly below MAD 0.5, and pass actual upload/draw/identity receipts through canonical, idle, ignored input and 960x600 resize phases. All 16 exact275/shared phases and 5 blend phases are pixel-exact; the three full-size SDL ordinary-blend phases differ in one channel by one unit on one pixel (full MAD 3.616898148148148e-7, foreground MAD 0.00002853392683901158). Ordinary scene142, TAA scene261 and scene44 pass the full sweep. Corpus verification matches 975 digest rows plus one provenance-only generated row.
